stem: ![](asset:P000275-stem-1)A boat can row at a speed of 5 m/s in still water. It sets its course at $37{^\circ}$ with the normal to river bank as shown. The velocity of the river is 2 m/s and its width is 50 m. The boat starts from A and B is directly opposite point. What will be the drift of the boat when it reaches the other side?

assets.alt: A river 50 m wide flowing to the right at 2 m/s. A swimmer starts at A on one bank with speed 5 m/s, directed at 37° upstream from the line AB; B is directly opposite A.
